authority: Stream Bandit TCG background and card-art production blueprint

production_rules.crop_rule: Keep the focal subject inside the central safe area so the same master survives Battle/Collection/Deck compact object-fit:cover crops.

background_production.style_direction: Dark enchanted realm; floating-world depth; cyan/prismatic energy with restrained gold; atmospheric rather than busy; no baked navigation, buttons, labels, card frames or page copy.

first_batch.design_language: Deep indigo/cosmic-blue Astral palette; luminous starlight, orbit lines, constellations and dreamlike depth. Evolution lines must visibly read as the same lineage. Keep silhouettes distinct at compact card size.

cards.brief: Tiny youthful astral scout with a bright star-core and sparse orbital dust; curious, light-footed, simple silhouette; establish the Stardot -> Orbitail -> Cosmarch lineage.
Teen evolution of Stardot; same recognizable core features, longer orbit-tracing tail/ribbons and controlled celestial motion; visual emphasis on prediction and ordered paths.
Adult culmination of the Stardot line; confident constellation navigator with broad orbital geometry and chart-like star markings; powerful but elegant, future-reading theme.
Small lunar creature with crescent highlights and soft moon-glow; observant pose and secret/reward-glimpse mood; establish the Moonbit -> Comettail -> Nebulynx lineage.
Teen evolution of Moonbit; clearly related face/body language, now with a luminous comet tail and sweeping reward-arc motion; more agile and confident.
Adult cosmic lynx; nebula-textured mane/fur, starfield eyes and a strong feline silhouette; should visually combine lunar secrecy, reward awareness and starfall power.
Standalone celestial manta gliding through high-altitude starlight; broad readable wings, comet wake and passing-orbit motion; pack-only identity should feel special without changing gameplay.
Standalone astral tortoise with an orbital-ring shell and gravity-field glow; sturdy central silhouette, defensive forecast/shield visual language.
Prismatic owl with oversized luminous eyes refracting hidden starlight; clean wing silhouette and spectral highlights; insight/observation is the visual story.
Massive starfield whale swimming through a cosmic current; gravitational wake, calm scale and deep-space grandeur; readable silhouette even when cropped small.

Mythic dream cartographer framed by living constellation maps, horizon folds and time-bending star paths; premium focal composition with unmistakable mythic presence, without baking rarity text into the raw art.
